{{Quote|Does Wing Tip Theel still operate out of Algar?''"<br />"''Wing Tip? I think so. He did last time I talked to him.|[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]]|<ref name="PoT">''[[Planet of Twilight]]''</ref>}}
'''Wing Tip Theel''' was a small time [[Slicer/Legends|slicer]] who operated out of [[Algara II]] and colleague of [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] around [[13 BBY/Legends|13 BBY]].
